Strong liquidity (current ratio 1.71), a very solid capital base (equity at about 47.5% of assets), and substantial retained earnings support high credit quality, while EBIT of 7,508M on 18,015M of revenue indicates exceptional operating profitability. Still, with only balance-sheet and operating figures and no debt-maturity, cash-flow, or interest-coverage detail, the safest finely grained assessment is in the high single-A range rather than the AA tier.

DECISION: A+
